textwithimage.text:
Intel Atom® E3800 (“Bay Trail-I”)

The TQ Mini Module TQMxE38C is designed to deliver efficient and dependable x86-based computing solutions, utilizing the renowned PICMG standard COM Express Mini (COM.0 R2.1). Powered by Intel Atom E3800 (Bay Trail-I) processors, this compact module offers exceptional reliability, making it suitable for 24/7 certified applications.

Engineered for ultra-low power consumption, the TQMxE38C is optimized for power efficiency without compromising performance. It features TQMx86 board controllers with flexible expansion options, allowing customization to meet specific application requirements. The module boasts a robust and durable design, with the option for protective coating, expanding its usability in rugged industrial, railway, and aviation environments.

With support for extended temperature ranges, the TQMxE38C is also suitable for outdoor applications, offering reliability even in challenging conditions. It incorporates DDR3L memory, ECC protection, and extensive connectivity options, including USB 3.0, Gigabit Ethernet, multiple serial ports, and PCIe interfaces.

FPGA engineers will appreciate the module's compatibility with COM Express Compact Type 6 and its ability to provide powerful computing while conserving energy. The TQ Mini Module TQMxE38C is a versatile and dependable solution for a wide range of embedded computing needs, combining Intel's trusted technology with TQ Systems' expertise in compact and reliable hardware design.

text.text:
Features

  • Efficient Intel Atom E3800 Processor: Powered by Intel's Bay Trail-I architecture, this module delivers reliable performance with a focus on power efficiency.

  • Customizable Expansion Options: The TQMxE38C features TQMx86 board controllers that allow for flexible customization, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of applications.

  • Rugged and Robust Design: Designed to withstand demanding environments, this module's robust build quality and protective coating option make it suitable for industrial, railway, and aviation settings.

  • Extended Temperature Support: With support for extended temperature ranges, this module can operate reliably in outdoor and challenging conditions.

  • Comprehensive Connectivity: The module offers an array of connectivity options, including USB 3.0, Gigabit Ethernet, multiple serial ports, and PCIe interfaces, providing extensive integration possibilities for FPGA engineers.

Graphics
  • 1x LVDS Interface (18/24-bit, Single/Dual Channel)

Communications Interfaces
  • Ethernet - 1x Gbit Ehternet
  • USB - 1x USB 3.0 | 7x USB 2.0
  • Serial Ports - 2x Serial Ports
Other Interfaces
  • PCIe - 3x PCIe 2.0

General

  • Power supply - 4.75 V - 20 V / 5 V Standby (optional) / 3 V Battery/GoldCAP (optional)
